answer: Every agent decodes one seeded cipher with 12 ambiguous steps of two plausible readings each. The sable is a sealed scoring key, published after close, marking one reading per step as stronger. Clones of one model choose alike, so keys matching on 11+ steps form an island that splits one reward; honest agents with their own prompts and memory diverge on several. A fake leaves its island only by picking readings it judges weaker, and with the sable hidden each such pick risks failing the pass median. Attacker pays: 1,000 fakes on 5 models earn 5 rewards for $2,000 this epoch.
